title: Dead text or binding clause? Measuring and restoring constraint influence in black-box LLM dialogues
abstract: arXiv:2608.12599v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-turn dialogues let users revoke constraints as easily as impose them, but revocation does not reliably take effect: models keep enacting withdrawn requirements (occasionally beneath comments asserting their removal), a failure we call \emph{behavioral relapse}, or revocation inertia. No existing instrument measures this influence per clause, predicts it before delivery, or repairs it under matched budgets. \sysname{} closes the three gaps through the model API alone: a contract ledger pairs every constraint with an executable checker, records revocations as tombstones, and compiles the net constraint state ahead of time into a single specification; a sequential ablation probe measures per-clause adherence and incremental behavioral effect; a repair ladder operates under token- and attempt-matched budgets. On \dataname{} (\NTasks{} HumanEval tasks, \NClauses{} verified checkers), relapse at an 8B operating point climbs from \ScaleDe

translated_title: 死文本还是约束条款？在黑盒大语言模型对话中测量并恢复约束影响力
translated_abstract: 多轮对话让用户既能轻松施加约束，也能轻松撤销约束，但撤销并不总能可靠生效：模型会继续执行已被撤回的要求（有时甚至在声称已删除的评论之下），我们将这种失败称为“行为复发”或“撤销惯性”。目前没有任何工具能逐条测量这种约束影响力、在交付前预测它，或在匹配预算下修复它。\sysname{} 仅通过模型API填补了这三个空白：一个合同账本将每个约束与可执行检查器配对，将撤销记录为墓碑标记，并提前将净约束状态编译为单一规范；一个顺序消融探针测量逐条约束的遵守情况和增量行为效应；一个修复阶梯在令牌和尝试匹配的预算下运作。在\dataname{}（\NTasks{}个人工智能评估任务，\NClauses{}个验证检查器）上，8B运行点的复发率从\ScaleDe{}开始上升。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种通过模型API在黑盒多轮对话中测量、预测并修复约束撤销后模型行为复发问题的新方法，包括合同账本、顺序消融探针和修复阶梯三部分。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel method to measure, predict, and repair behavioral relapse after constraint revocation in black-box multi-turn dialogues via the model API alone, comprising a contract ledger, a sequential ablation probe, and a repair ladder.
